visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a static shot of a promotional poster for 'Super Live! 2025 Dream Beats' featuring a female drummer in a pink shirt. The poster is yellow with black text, mounted on a vertical surface. (2) Inside a dimly lit event space, rows of black folding chairs are laid out. A man in a vibrant blue short-sleeved shirt moves through the rows, placing white rolled-up items on each seat. The room has industrial ceilings and gray curtains. (3) Outside the venue, a group of fans wearing casual summer clothing and masks gathers under a glass and metal awning. The lighting is natural daylight, reflecting off the building's glass doors. (4) Close-ups show merchandise including purple drumsticks labeled 'S.WHITE' and black bags. A hand enters the frame holding a smartphone to scan a QR code presented by another person, indicating a check-in process. (5) On a stage with dark backdrops, the main character, a woman with short dark hair, sits behind a professional drum kit. She holds a microphone and gestures with her hands while smiling. (6) A dynamic performance montage follows. The drummer, wearing a purple mesh jersey, plays energetically. The lighting is high-contrast with red and blue spotlights. (7) Guest performers appear, including a woman in a white tube top and another in an orange striped shirt, singing alongside the drummer. The crowd is visible in the foreground, waving purple light sticks. (8) The video concludes with the performers posing for a group photo with the audience in the background, followed by a graphic of a drum with 'S.white' text.

A faint layer of environmental indoor room tone is present during the initial setup shots. (2) A clear female voice begins an enthusiastic greeting and narration. Her pitch is moderate, and her speech rate is steady, conveying excitement. The BGM remains at a consistent volume underneath the vocals. (3) As the visuals transition to performance, sharp percussive drum impacts become highly prominent, synchronized with visual stick hits. Intense crowd cheering and high-pitched screams are heard, creating a high-arousal atmosphere. (4) The music volume ducks slightly as the narrator's tone shifts to a more calm and sincere quality, expressing gratitude or prayer. The rhythmic intensity of the drums pauses momentarily for atmospheric piano notes. (5) The energetic pop music swells again for the finale. Multiple female singing voices overlap with rhythmic percussion and heavy bass. The track concludes with a long-duration swell of loud audience applause and cheering.

It aims to showcase the energy of the performance, the dedication of the staff, and the artist's gratitude toward her fans through a high-tempo visual and auditory experience.
